results.note: Confirms the earlier schema-version assertion failures in the old serial log came from stale test binaries.

Corrected the fixture to use the existing DeferredCommit test path, which inserts a real deferred foreign-key violation inside the original migration transaction. Preflight remains before migration, rollback and schema preservation assertions remain. The actual engine returned SQLite foreign-key error code 787.

20-second watchdog reproduced. The test never observed its required held-return state; retained fixture observed pool_closed=true, pool_size=0, registry_status=Pending. Do not interpret as a normal-return close guarantee passing.
Current Windows test identity was denied access (Win32 OS error 5) while committing the protected node identity. This is an environment-limited result, not a product pass.
Child Node startup was denied access to its data-directory lock (Win32 OS error 5); the fixture then panicked when it expected the started child. Not treated as a product regression or pass.

The real Node fixture returned ReadFailure even when P1_DATA_ROOT and RPC_FIXTURE_ROOT pointed to precreated isolated workspace directories. Startup limitation remains unresolved; the serial shared-view cluster is not counted green.
